measurement_definitions.HOLDS: true body-bound dual-finger contact supports grasp; missing contact is unknown
measurement_definitions.ON_INSIDE: official annotation plus contact/distance/bbox proxy; not geometric proof
measurement_definitions.NEAR_AT_WORK_AREA: public contract only; no reachability threshold invented
measurement_definitions.is_open: normalized door >=0.9 open; all <=0.01 closed; intermediate unknown
measurement_definitions.rack_extended: recorded normalized rack0 >=0.8 extended; <=0.1 retracted; intermediate unknown
measurement_definitions.cycle_complete: WAIT segment must have active pre-state and inactive post-state
measurement_definitions.washed_locations: V6 sequential official washed_loc history; all three positions true
measurement_definitions.scrub_coverage_complete: V5 recorded contact locations/count, >=5 distinct contacts and spread >=0.1m
measurement_definitions.post_grounded_entities: post-based identity mapping retained separately; outcomes not independent support
